description: This file defines the code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page called AdminLeaderboard, used within an online examination system. It contains event handlers for page load and button clicks, with some commented-out database interaction code.

classes.name: AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminLeaderboard ASP.NET Web Forms page, handling page events and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently does nothing as the main code is commented out.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the home button to navigate to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the profile button to navigate to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the leaderboard button, currently empty.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Handles the search button click, setting session variable; database searching code is commented out.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles logout button click, transferring to LoginPage.aspx.
